use_case_summary: Mobile-first multiplayer social game. Primary is real-time public chat + ephemeral private messages. Targets: p95 latency <= 150ms for text responses in NA; expect bursty concurrency (1.5k concurrent chatters during events). Need hosted API self-serve to integrate quickly, strong content-moderation primitives (profanity, spam detection, rate limiting) and toggles for strictness. Cost-sensitive — early monetization; prefer per-token pricing and recommendations for batching/caching. Open to small/quantized models if it lowers latency/cost.
technical_requirements: REST + streaming responses; SDKs for Unity and React Native; per-user rate limits; ability to attach user_id/session metadata for moderation and audit; low cold-start latency for short prompts (~20–80 tokens).
acceptance_criteria_for_poc: 1) Integrate hosted API in demo lobby with streaming messaging; 2) Meet p95 < 180ms for NA mobile tests at ~200 concurrent connections; 3) Demonstrate profanity filter + webhook alerts for policy hits; 4) Estimate monthly cost for projected 500k messages/month.
